newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan may lend funds for move to digital broadcast.
newsitem.headline: Japan may lend funds for move to digital broadcast.

text.p: Japan's private broadcasters may be able to receive loans from the Japan Development Bank to switch to digital broadcasting from analog, Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Minister Hisao Horinouchi told a news briefing on Friday.

Speaking about lightening the burden of investment in digital technology, he said: "I think it will take the form of loans, maybe the Development Bank or some such body." But he ruled out the use of direct government subsidies.
Horinouchi said broadcasters would have to invest in digital technology.
"It's unavoidable. If they don't act now then they will just lag behind. We have to switch to digital in the next three to five years," he said.
